import sys

def generate_prices(n):
    # Initialize the adjacency matrix with zeros
    prices = [[0] * n for _ in range(n)]
    
    # Fill the upper triangle of the matrix with distinct prices
    current_price = 1
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i + 1, n):
            prices[i][j] = current_price
            prices[j][i] = current_price
            current_price += 1
    
    return prices
